description: File Storage Analysis using normalized stats schema (v2) - optimized for large datasets

panels.description: Combined capacity of all scanned volumes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (s.TotalUsedBytes + s.TotalFreeBytes) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Total Storage

panels.description: Total storage currently in use across all scanned volumes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.TotalUsedBytes / 1073741824.0 AS UsedGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Used Space

panels.description: Overall storage utilization percentage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * s.TotalUsedBytes / NULLIF(s.TotalUsedBytes + s.TotalFreeBytes, 0) AS PctUsed
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Used %

panels.description: Total number of files scanned

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.TotalFiles
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Files

panels.description: Large files (>100MB) not modified in 2+ years

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.StaleFilesBytes / 1073741824.0 AS StaleGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Stale Data

panels.description: Estimated wasted space from potential duplicate files (same name+size, >10MB)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.DuplicateCandidatesWastedBytes / 1073741824.0 AS DupWastedGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Dup Waste

panels.description: Total size of temp/cache files (directories marked as IsTempCache)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.TempCacheFilesBytes / 1073741824.0 AS TempGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Temp/Cache

panels.description: Files in OS-managed directories ($Recycle.Bin, System Volume Information, etc.) that Windows controls automatically

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.SystemManagedFilesBytes / 1073741824.0 AS SystemGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.BatchSummary s
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: System Managed

panels.description: Scan metadata including last access time collection status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'Server' AS Metric, b.ServerName AS Value FROM FileSizes.stats.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Collected', CONVERT(VARCHAR, b.CollectedAtUtc, 120) FROM FileSizes.stats.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tool', b.ToolName + ' v' + ISNULL(b.ToolVersion, '?') FROM FileSizes.stats.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Collected By', b.CollectedBy FROM FileSizes.stats.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Duration', CAST(b.DurationSec AS VARCHAR) + ' sec' FROM FileSizes.stats.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Access Time', CASE WHEN b.AccessTimeCollected = 1 THEN 'Collected' ELSE 'Not Collected (' + ISNULL(b.LastAccessStatus, 'disabled') + ')' END FROM FileSizes.stats.ScanBatch b WHERE b.BatchId = '${batchid}'

panels.title: Scan Info

panels.description: Breakdown of storage by volume/drive

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    v.VolumeName,
    v.VolumeLabel,
    v.TotalSizeBytes / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB,
    v.FreeSizeBytes / 1073741824.0 AS FreeGB,
    CASE WHEN v.TotalSizeBytes > 0
         THEN 100.0 * (v.TotalSizeBytes - v.FreeSizeBytes) / v.TotalSizeBytes
         ELSE NULL
    END AS PctUsed,
    v.FileCount,
    v.DirectoryCount
FROM FileSizes.stats.ScanVolume v
WHERE v.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY v.VolumeName

panels.title: Volume Summary

panels.description: Top 20 directories by total file size (using pre-aggregated stats)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 20
    d.DirectoryName AS Folder,
    d.TotalFileSize / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.Directory d
WHERE d.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND d.TotalFileSize > 0
ORDER BY d.TotalFileSize DESC

panels.title: Top 20 Folders by Size

panels.description: Storage by file type using pre-computed extension column

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 10
    UPPER(ISNULL(f.Extension, '(no ext)')) AS Extension,
    SUM(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.FileSize IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.Extension
ORDER BY SUM(f.FileSize) DESC

panels.title: Space by Extension (Top 10)

panels.description: Distribution of storage by file age (based on ModifiedTime)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AgeCategory, TotalBytes / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_FileAgeDistribution
WHERE BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY SortOrder

panels.title: File Age Distribution

panels.description: Storage usage by extension using pre-computed column

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    ISNULL(f.Extension, '(no ext)') AS Extension,
    COUNT(*) AS FileCount,
    SUM(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB,
    AVG(f.FileSize) / 1048576.0 AS AvgSizeMB,
    MAX(f.FileSize) / 1073741824.0 AS LargestGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.FileEntry f
WHERE f.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND f.FileSize IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.Extension
ORDER BY SUM(f.FileSize) DESC

panels.title: File Type Distribution (click extension to drill down)

panels.description: Top-level folders using pre-aggregated directory stats

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50
    d.DirectoryId,
    d.DirectoryName,
    d.FileCount,
    d.TotalFileSize / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.Directory d
WHERE d.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY d.TotalFileSize DESC

panels.title: Top Folders (click to drill down)

panels.description: Large files not modified in 2+ years using view for full path

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
    v.VolumeName,
    s.FullPath,
    s.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    s.ModifiedTime,
    s.DaysSinceModified
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_StaleFiles s
JOIN FileSizes.stats.ScanVolume v ON v.BatchId = s.BatchId AND v.ScanVolumeId = s.ScanVolumeId
WHERE s.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY s.FileSize DESC

panels.title: Stale Files (>100MB, not modified in 2+ years)

panels.description: Potential duplicates using pre-computed view

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
    d.FileName,
    d.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    d.CopyCount,
    d.WastedBytes / 1073741824.0 AS WastedGB
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_DuplicateCandidates d
WHERE d.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY d.WastedBytes DESC

panels.title: Duplicate Candidates (same name+size, >10MB)

panels.description: Files in directories marked as temp/cache using IsTempCache flag

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
    t.FullPath,
    t.FileName,
    t.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    t.ModifiedTime
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_TempCacheFiles t
WHERE t.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY t.FileSize DESC

panels.title: Temp/Cache Files (largest)

panels.description: Files in system-managed directories ($Recycle.Bin, System Volume Information, etc.)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
    t.FullPath,
    t.FileName,
    t.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    t.ModifiedTime
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_SystemManagedFiles t
WHERE t.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY t.FileSize DESC

panels.title: System Managed Files (largest)

panels.description: Largest files using view for full path

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50
    v.VolumeName,
    l.FullPath,
    l.FileSize / 1073741824.0 AS SizeGB,
    l.ModifiedTime,
    l.AccessedTime
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_LargestFiles l
JOIN FileSizes.stats.ScanVolume v ON v.BatchId = l.BatchId AND v.ScanVolumeId = l.ScanVolumeId
WHERE l.BatchId = '${batchid}'
ORDER BY l.FileSize DESC

panels.title: Top 50 Largest Files

panels.description: Files with selected extension using pre-computed Extension column

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200
    fp.FullPath,
    fp.FileName,
    fp.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    fp.ModifiedTime
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_FileWithPath fp
WHERE fp.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND '${extension}' <> ''
  AND LOWER(fp.Extension) = LOWER('${extension}')
ORDER BY fp.FileSize DESC

panels.title: Files with .${extension} extension

panels.description: Files within selected directory using DirectoryId join

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 200
    fp.FullPath,
    fp.FileName,
    fp.FileSize / 1048576.0 AS SizeMB,
    fp.ModifiedTime
FROM FileSizes.stats.vw_FileWithPath fp
WHERE fp.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND '${directoryid}' <> ''
  AND fp.DirectoryId = CAST(REPLACE('${directoryid}', ',', '') AS INT)
ORDER BY fp.FileSize DESC

panels.title: Files in Directory #${directoryid}

panels.description: Navigate the directory tree

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    d.DirectoryId,
    d.DirectoryName,
    d.FullPath,
    d.Depth,
    d.FileCount,
    d.TotalFileSize / 1073741824.0 AS TotalGB,
    CASE WHEN d.IsTempCache = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE '' END AS TempCache,
    CASE WHEN d.IsSystemManaged = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE '' END AS SystemManaged
FROM FileSizes.stats.Directory d
WHERE d.BatchId = '${batchid}'
  AND d.Depth <= 3
ORDER BY d.TotalFileSize DESC

panels.title: Directory Browser (Depth <= 3)
